items.label: U.S. House
items.text: Elected to the U.S. House in 1994 after the retirement of Rep. Don Edwards; in office since January 1995; currently represents California's 18th District. (sources: Office of Rep. Zoe Lofgren (house.gov) https://lofgren.house.gov/sites/evo-subsites/lofgren.house.gov/files/evo-media-document/Zoe%20Long%20Bio_2024.pdf [search summary, primary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoe_Lofgren [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Santa Clara County Board of Supervisors
items.text: Member of the Santa Clara County Board of Supervisors, 1981 to 1994 per her official site (Voteview lists 1980 to 1994). (sources: Office of Rep. Zoe Lofgren (house.gov) https://lofgren.house.gov/about [search summary, primary]; Voteview (UCLA) https://voteview.com/person/29504/zoe-lofgren [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Early career
items.text: Staff assistant to Rep. Don Edwards; partner in the immigration law firm Webber and Lofgren, 1978 to 1980; taught immigration law at the University of Santa Clara School of Law, 1977 to 1980. (sources: Office of Rep. Zoe Lofgren (house.gov) https://lofgren.house.gov/sites/evo-subsites/lofgren.house.gov/files/evo-media-document/Zoe%20Long%20Bio_2024.pdf [search summary, primary])

items.label: Education
